diagram_previews.alt: Regular hexagram with six blue side lines and three red lines through opposite tips and the centre. Dots mark the six tips, the six inner hexagon vertices, the midpoints of the six blue sides (where the red lines cross them) and the centre: nineteen points, five on each of the nine lines.
